excerpts:
World of Warcraft Forums

# WoW Up |Curse | Wago

Guides UI and Macro

[Bigrez-2270725](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Bigrez-2270725) (Bigrez) April 16, 2026, 10:28am 1

Hi — I’d been using CurseForge or Wago depending on where an addon was available, but I recently added WoWUp after an addon pack recommended it as the main way to manage everything. I can see all my addons in WoWUp and update them there, but CurseForge and Wago still show updates available too.

Any recommendations on the simplest way to handle this? Also, is there any reason to keep updating through Wago or CurseForge if I’m already updating everything in WoWUp?

[Linaori-2918678](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Linaori-2918678) (Linaori) April 16, 2026, 4:11pm 2

Neither versions of wowup track changes of each other, or other addon managers for that matter. Best is to have only 1 of the 2. If you need both because some addon isn’t available, ignore everything except that one addon.

1 Like
[Fizzlemizz-3415](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Fizzlemizz-3415) (Fizzlemizz) April 16, 2026, 4:52pm 3

Updating an addon more than once won’t make a difference to the code that’s in place once you’re done (assuming all sites have the same (latest) version).

1 Like

[Bigrez-2270725](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Bigrez-2270725) (Bigrez) April 16, 2026, 5:53pm 4

Sorry - I’m confused by this - can you explain. Do you mean only have curse or Wago? If i delete Wago, will all the addons move to curse that are available on curse if I sync Curse with my addon folder?

[Fizzlemizz-3415](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Fizzlemizz-3415) (Fizzlemizz) April 16, 2026, 6:32pm 5

The Curse updater only lists addons on Curse. The Wago updater does the same for Wago, WoWUp lists addons on Curse, Wago and WoWInterface etc.

If you have WoWUp and one of the other installers you will be promted to update common addons by both updaters.
Deleting the installer won’t “move” the addons, it will just restrict the sites used to find/dowload addons to whatever sites your remaining updater(s) support.

1 Like

[Bigrez-2270725](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Bigrez-2270725) (Bigrez) April 16, 2026, 6:37pm 6

Easy question - if I have the raider io addon which is supported by both wago and curse, but I downloaded it on wago. If I delete wago, will it move to curse app manager?

[Fizzlemizz-3415](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Fizzlemizz-3415) (Fizzlemizz) April 16, 2026, 6:44pm 7

If the addon is on Curse then the Curse downloader should already list it so it would just download it from Curse.

Addon aurthors decide which sites they want to use for people to download their addon(s) and it is up to the aurthors to keep those sites up-to-date. The (legit) download sites just provide a place for people get the addons that have been uploaded to them.

[Linaori-2918678](https://us.forums.blizzard.
com/en/wow/u/Linaori-2918678) (Linaori) April 17, 2026, 7:04am 8

Rezdog:

> Sorry - I’m confused by this - can you explain. Do you mean only have curse or Wago? If i delete Wago, will all the addons move to curse that are available on curse if I sync Curse with my addon folder?
> 
>

The TL;DR is that both WowUp CF and WowUp Wago track addons independently. You only need both versions if there’s an addon on Wago that isn’t on CF, and vice versa.

If all of your addons are available on CF, you don’t need the Wago version at all. If you do need the Wago version for a single addon, you can right click and check the ignore button in the Wago version, so only the CF version will be updating it.

Rezdog:

> Easy question - if I have the raider io addon which is supported by both wago and curse, but I downloaded it on wago. If I delete wago, will it move to curse app manager?
> 
>

Not automatically.
In theory there’s a “re-scan” you can do, but there’s currently a bug in the CF app that will “forget” where the addon is coming from if you press that button (TL;DR is that fingerprinting addons is complicated). You can always reinstall the addon if that happens. You can also just uninstall it in the Wago version and then install it in the CF version.

[Bigrez-2270725](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Bigrez-2270725) (Bigrez) April 17, 2026, 11:20am 9

Very helpful - will I lose all my settings per addon - if I delete them from WAGO and reinstall in the CF?

[Linaori-2918678](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Linaori-2918678) (Linaori) April 17, 2026, 12:03pm 10

Yes, as both are isolated apps

[Fizzlemizz-3415](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Fizzlemizz-3415) (Fizzlemizz) April 17, 2026, 2:41pm 11

The question is a bit vague.
Moving from one downloader to another, you won’t loose the game settings you’ve made to the addon itself (in-game) as these are stored by the game, not the downloader.

[Belechannas-1977035](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Belechannas-1977035) (Belechannas) April 17, 2026, 7:36pm 12

To be safe, before making any changes, just create backup copies of your WTF and Interface folders.
